payload.title: Adopt in Chatticus
payload.description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Chatticus's alarms are in `infra/lib/alarms.ts` with an email option on the topic; its accounts already take the forwarder (kanbus-64fc60). Add app events and a brand; remove its SNS email. Chatticus's repo and session own the merge.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.

**Depends on:** kanbus-0c3a43, kanbus-64fc60
